scientific_integrity: An all-parameter analytic counterexample family and a separate exhaustive finite classification up to seven vertices, corroborated by a separate exact integral Smith normal forms on all unlabeled connected unicyclic graph types of those orders.
scientific_limitations: Does not classify all unicyclic or forest graph families satisfying the neighborhood-deletion vanishing condition. The least-order uniqueness claim uses an exact finite classification; historical priority is assessed to the best of available literature.
title: A sharp connected unicyclic obstruction to neighborhood-homology vanishing
